@integer_combination_criterion : ∀ {n r : ℕ} (d e₀ : Fin n → ℤ) (c : ℤ) (b : Fin r → Fin n → ℤ)

restricted_ledger_combination_criterion : ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n r : ℕ}
  (Ω : Set.{0} (IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n)),
  (∀ (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n), Membership.mem.{0, 0} Ω x → ∀ (j : Fin n), Ne.{1} (x j) 0) →
    ∀ (w : Fin n → ℤ) (σ : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]),
      (∀ (j : Fin n), Ne.{1} (a j) 0) →
        ∀ (x₀ : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
          Membership.mem.{0, 0} Ω x₀ →
            ∀ (b : Fin r → Fin n → ℤ),
              (∀ (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
                  Membership.mem.{0, 0} Ω x →
                    ∃ lam,
                      Eq.{1}
                        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x)
                          (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x₀))
                        (∑ i, HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (lam i) (b i))) →
                (∀ (i : Fin r),
                    ∃ m x lam,
                      (∀ (k : Fin m), Membership.mem.{0, 0} Ω (x k)) ∧
                        Eq.{1} (b i)
                          (∑ k,
                            HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (lam k)
                              (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p (x k))
                                (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x₀)))) →
                  ((∀ (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
                      Membership.mem.{0, 0} Ω x →
                        Eq.{1}
                          (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w
                            (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x)))
                          (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w x)) ↔
                    Eq.{1}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                          (dot (fun j => HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (w (σ j)) (w j)) (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x₀))
                          (∑ j, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (w (σ j)) (a j).valuation))
                        0 ∧
                      ∀ (i : Fin r), Eq.{1} (dot (fun j => HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (w (σ j)) (w j)) (b i)) 0)

full_domain_iff : ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℤ) (σ : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n))
  (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]),
  (∀ (j : Fin n), Ne.{1} (a j) 0) →
    ((∀ (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
        (∀ (j : Fin n), Ne.{1} (x j) 0) →
          Eq.{1}
            (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x)))
            (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w x)) ↔
      (∀ (j : Fin n), Eq.{1} (w (σ j)) (w j)) ∧ Eq.{1} (∑ j, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (w (σ j)) (a j).valuation) 0)

finite_integer_span_membership_example : (Membership.mem.{0, 0} finiteIntegerDomain fun x => 0) ∧
  (∀ (e : Fin 1 → ℤ),
      Membership.mem.{0, 0} finiteIntegerDomain e →
        ∃ lam,
          Eq.{1} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} e fun x => 0) (∑ i, HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (lam i) (integerUnitGenerator i))) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 1),
        ∃ m e lam,
          (∀ (k : Fin m), Membership.mem.{0, 0} finiteIntegerDomain (e k)) ∧
            Eq.{1} (integerUnitGenerator i)
              (∑ k, HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (lam k) (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (e k) fun x => 0))) ∧
      (¬∃ e,
            Membership.mem.{0, 0} finiteIntegerDomain e ∧
              Eq.{1} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} e fun x => 0) (integerUnitGenerator 0)) ∧
        ∀ (d : Fin 1 → ℤ) (c : ℤ),
          (∀ (e : Fin 1 → ℤ),
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} finiteIntegerDomain e → Eq.{1} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (dot d e) c) 0) ↔
            Eq.{1} c 0 ∧ ∀ (i : Fin 1), Eq.{1} (dot d (integerUnitGenerator i)) 0

def Candidates.RestrictedLedger.finiteIntegerDomain : Set.{0} (Fin 1 → ℤ) :=
Set.ofPred.{0} fun e => (Eq.{1} e fun x => 0) ∨ (Eq.{1} e fun x => 2) ∨ Eq.{1} e fun x => 3

def Candidates.RestrictedLedger.integerUnitGenerator : Fin 1 → Fin 1 → ℤ :=
fun x x_1 => 1
'Candidates.RestrictedLedger.finiteIntegerDomain' does not depend on any axioms
'Candidates.RestrictedLedger.integerUnitGenerator' does not depend on any axioms

restricted_ledger_span_criterion : ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n r : ℕ} (Ω : Set (IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n)),
  (∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ (j : Fin n), x j ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (w : Fin n → ℤ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]),
      (∀ (j : Fin n), a j ≠ 0) →
        ∀ x₀ ∈ Ω,
          ∀ (b : Fin r → Fin n → ℤ),
            (∀ x ∈ Ω,
                ∃ lam,
                  IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x - IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x₀ = ∑ i, lam i • b i) →
              (∀ (i : Fin r), MemDiffSpanOn p Ω x₀ (b i)) →
                ((∀ x ∈ Ω,
                    IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w
                        (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x)) =
                      IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w x) ↔
                  dot (fun j => w (σ j) - w j) (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x₀) +
                        ∑ j, w (σ j) * (a j).valuation =
                      0 ∧
                    ∀ (i : Fin r), dot (fun j => w (σ j) - w j) (b i) = 0)

full_domain_iff : ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℤ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
  (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]),
  (∀ (j : Fin n), a j ≠ 0) →
    ((∀ (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
        (∀ (j : Fin n), x j ≠ 0) →
          IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x)) =
            IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.weightedLedger p w x) ↔
      (∀ (j : Fin n), w (σ j) = w j) ∧ ∑ j, w (σ j) * (a j).valuation = 0)

def Candidates.RestrictedLedger.MemDiffSpan : {n : ℕ} → Set (Fin n → ℤ) → (Fin n → ℤ) → (Fin n → ℤ) → Prop :=
fun {n} S e₀ v => ∃ m e lam, (∀ (k : Fin m), e k ∈ S) ∧ v = ∑ k, lam k • (e k - e₀)

def Candidates.RestrictedLedger.MemDiffSpanOn : (p : ℕ) →
  [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] →
    {n : ℕ} → Set (IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n) → IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n → (Fin n → ℤ) → Prop :=
fun p [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n} Ω x₀ v =>
  ∃ m x lam,
    (∀ (k : Fin m), x k ∈ Ω) ∧
      v = ∑ k, lam k • (IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p (x k) - IUTBridge.WeightedLedger.vprofile p x₀)
